Which bundle each audience gets.
The VERSION is no longer in this file. It is derived as 1.0.<commit count> (scripts/ota-version.mjs) because it was a duty and duties get skipped: builds 239-249 all changed web code and all published as 1.0.2, so every device was told the newest bundle was the one it already had. Eleven builds delivered nothing, silently.
public  - who gets it. "auto" means the version THIS build publishes, so shipping is the default and holding a release back is the deliberate act. That is the right way round: the old default was null, and forgetting shipped nothing to nobody with no warning. Pin a dotted version to roll back - every device drops to it on the next launch, provided it is still hosted. null still means nobody at all.
beta    - null by DEFAULT: there is no beta, and opted-in devices get the public release like everyone else. Set it to a version only while something is actually being tested.
minNative - the lowest APK versionName this bundle runs on. Raise it in the same commit that makes web code depend on something new in the native shell. The endpoint refuses to serve a bundle to an older APK, and the app tells the player to update from the store.
keep    - how many bundles stay hosted. Each deploy carries the previous ones forward from the live site so every listed version stays fetchable from the same origin.
delta   - true serves the per-file manifest, so an update costs only what changed rather than the whole bundle. Set false to fall back to the plain zip from the server side, without a new build, if the manifest path is ever suspected.
